newsitem.title: USA: IMF staff official to meet with Albanian leaders.
newsitem.headline: IMF staff official to meet with Albanian leaders.

text.p: An International Monetary Fund staff official will meet with members of the new Albanian government, including Prime Minister Bashkim Fino, in Rome within a day or two, a spokeswoman for the lending agency said Monday.
"The purpose of the visit was to reestablish contact with the government," the IMF said."
The official will also meet with Finance Minister Arben Malaj. No futher details were given.

An IMF mission had been scheduled to visit Albania sometime in mid-March but this was delayed after conditions deteriorated in the country following the collapse of a string of pyramid savings schemes.
The IMF had approved a $58 million, three year loan program with Albania in July 1993 but the country was unable to meet the conditions and it went of track in mid-1995.
